pictures.formats: Pictures can be JPEG, PNG, BMP or TGA files.
pictures.unreadable: The picture could not be read: {reason}
@pictures.unreadable: {reason} is a message from the system in English, or a file name
pictures.not_kept: The picture could not be kept in the project: {reason}
@pictures.not_kept: {reason} is a message from the system, in English
pictures.added: The picture {file} lies on {count, plural, one {# tile} other {# tiles}}: line it up under Line up the picture.
@pictures.added: "Line up the picture" is the name of a section in the Satellite window: use the same words as there
pictures.not_removed: The picture could not be taken out of the project: {reason}
@pictures.not_removed: {reason} is a message from the system, in English
pictures.fit_not_saved: The picture's fit could not be saved: {reason}
@pictures.fit_not_saved: {reason} is a message from the system, in English
pictures.not_cut: The picture could not be cut onto its tiles: {reason}
@pictures.not_cut: {reason} is a message from the system, in English
